blockingFindings.description: V11 crouch and sit renders still expose the gray avatar across the upper inner thighs; the sewn shorts do not maintain opaque hip-flexion coverage, and neutral retains a narrow center gap.
V11 crouch and sit renders retain two long pointed strips below the rear seat. Neutral back is smoother, but the pose deformation remains visibly uncontrolled.
V11 neutral, crouch and sit renders still show broad faceted wrinkles and pinched folds around sleeves, underarms and jacket waist.
